races.paceDynamic: Blixen Force will dictate as the sole natural leader, setting a steady tempo without pressure in the opening stages. The prominent quartet of New Yorker, Maria Quiteria, and What A Girl Wants will track closely, with hold-up specialists Star Prospect and Velozee positioned towards the rear. With minimal early pace pressure, this creates a sustainable gallop that builds gradually, allowing the field to stay compact into the final furlong. This moderate pace dynamic clearly favours prominent runners who can position handily and kick, as they avoid the risk of being caught too far back when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the handy horses to travel smoothly and strike first when the race begins in earnest. New Yorker, Maria Quiteria, and What A Girl Wants are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Stars Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Star Prospect or Velozee get the perfect split at the right moment
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace gives the back-runners time to wind up their challenge, with Star Prospect's class edge and Velozee's finishing kick proving decisive. Their patient tactics pay dividends in a race lacking early burn.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Blixen Force Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Blixen Force's uncontested lead proves too valuable to peg back
scenarios.body: The front-runner capitalizes on soft fractions to maintain momentum, with the chasers leaving their moves too late on ground that doesn't aid late closers. Ben Coen's mount proves hard to catch from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Rebel Dance Unknown Factor
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced newcomer possesses undisclosed ability
scenarios.body: Joseph O'Brien's charge exploits the tactical race with natural ability that hasn't been fully exposed yet. The steady pace suits a horse whose style and capability remain largely mysterious.

races.paceDynamic: Greek Mythology and Iron Lily will contest the early lead, with Greek Mythology likely to secure it given his stronger recent form. The honest gallop these leaders create will stretch the field over this mile trip, preventing any tactical nonsense. Causeway, Neolithic and Take Charge Star will track the pace in the second rank, while the hold-up horses Andab, Geryon and Redemption Road face the challenge of making up ground against what should be solid sectionals. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can stay close to the pace and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Benefits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology and Iron Lily maintain honest fractions through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The tracking prominent runners get the perfect setup to strike in the straight, with the leaders vulnerable late on. Causeway and Neolithic are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology gets soft sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and prove too strong for the closers. Iron Lily lacks the class to go with him, leaving Greek Mythology with a winning advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the furlong pole, suiting the patient hold-up runners with tactical speed. Andab and Geryon can unleash their finishing kicks when it matters most in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tire dramatically in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where positioning trumps class, creating opportunities for outsiders. The mid-division runners benefit most as the race falls apart in front of them.

races.paceDynamic: Institute, Saint Agatha, and Slaney View will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Institute having shown consistent early speed and Saint Agatha carrying light weight at 127lbs. The trio will create a searching test of stamina over this 7f trip, particularly given the consistent good ground conditions throughout the day. This sustained pace will stretch the field and expose any fitness concerns, especially among those returning from long breaks. The pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish off a strong gallop, with prominent racers also well-placed to strike if positioned correctly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Institute, Saint Agatha and Slaney View all go forward as expected creating a fierce gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable for the leaders and set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to sweep past in the final furlong. Prevalence with her fresh legs after 178 days and Anushka's proven closing kick will benefit most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but one of the prominent runners gets the perfect stalking position
scenarios.body: Green Carrera or Sanctijude can track the pace without over-exerting and have enough left to strike when the leaders tire. Their tactical speed gives them the edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three pace-setters fail to cooperate or one drops back early
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical and suits horses with natural pace who can quicken off a slower rhythm. Saint Agatha's light weight becomes crucial in a sprint finish scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Institute or Saint Agatha get loose on the lead with tactical riding
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters capitalizes on superior fitness or class to hold on despite making the running. The light weight on Saint Agatha particularly aids this outcome.

races.paceDynamic: Sinmara, White Sand Beach, Sky Watch, and Kensington Lane will forge a strong early gallop in this Group 3 contest, with four confirmed front-runners ensuring no dawdling. The prominent brigade of Drop Dead Gorgeous, Pollenca, Wild Bessie, Caught U Sleeping, and Black Caviar Gold creates serious traffic concerns turning for home, as five horses vie for limited space behind the leaders. This sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina over the Curragh's testing mile. The combination of strong early pace and prominent congestion clearly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the scrimmaging and deliver late charges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays strong and prominent runners clash for racing room 2f out
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field while traffic problems hamper those racing prominently, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep through with clear runs. Mayflower and Alphecca benefit most from their tactical positioning and ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner secures ideal position just behind leaders without interference
scenarios.body: Black Caviar Gold or Caught U Sleeping could exploit their class advantage by tracking the pace perfectly and having first run on the leaders entering the straight. Their superior ratings give them the edge when positioned optimally.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Sinmara or Kensington Lane breaks clear approaching 2f out before others respond
scenarios.body: The leader establishes a decisive advantage while the prominent pack hesitates, making the gap too large for late closers to bridge despite the strong pace. Sinmara's OR99 and recent form make her the most likely to sustain a bold front-running effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners go too fast initially and fold collectively in final 2f
scenarios.body: When all pace-setters weaken simultaneously, it creates a tactical muddle where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize regardless of early position. This chaotic finish could see any runner from midfield back come through.

races.paceDynamic: Edward Hamilton will be the sole pace-setter from the gates, with no natural speed rivals to pressure him early. This creates a measured, controlled gallop through the first mile, with Adelaide River, Minnie Hauk, Tiberius Thunder and Beset sitting prominent behind the leader. The lack of pace pressure means Edward Hamilton can dictate terms until his known finishing limitations emerge in the final two furlongs, when the hold-up horses Cercene and Shaool will be delivered late. This shape strongly favours closers and prominent runners with finishing kick over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Edward Hamilton sets uncontested fractions and fades predictably in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows Cercene and Shaool to be perfectly positioned for late runs, with their hold-up styles ideally suited to picking off a tiring leader. Both have proven finishing kicks and benefit from the patient ride this race shape provides.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows a prominent runner to position perfectly and kick clear before the closers
scenarios.body: Minnie Hauk or Beset can stalk Edward Hamilton, inherit the lead at the two-furlong pole, and have enough left to resist late challenges. Their superior class and prominent running styles exploit the tactical tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Edward Hamilton Wire Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the uncontested lead allows Edward Hamilton to save enough energy to resist late challenges
scenarios.body: Despite his finishing limitations, the easy lead and slower fractions enable him to find a second wind when challenged. His front-running style finally gets the perfect race conditions to maximize his limited ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Adelaide River or Tiberius Thunder move to challenge Edward Hamilton before the turn
scenarios.body: This creates a faster middle section that sets up a different race dynamic, potentially compromising both the leader and early challengers. The injection of pace could favour horses with tactical speed who avoided the early burn.

races.paceDynamic: Genesis will lead alone from the gates with no other genuine front runners in this field. With 8 horses wanting prominent positions (Four Blondes, Imperial Dream, Reposado, Send Harry, This Guy, Tai Tam Bay, I'm Spartacus, Platino Bianco), severe traffic problems will develop from the 3f marker as they bunch behind Genesis on the rail. The uncontested leader Genesis can dictate fractions while the prominent brigade creates a wall effect, trapping the 11 hold-up horses behind them. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader Genesis and any hold-up horses with enough pace to navigate around the prominent traffic jam in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Genesis gets soft sectionals on the lead and the prominent brigade gets bunched
scenarios.body: Genesis enjoys dream racing conditions while the 8-horse prominent pack creates gridlock behind, allowing the leader to kick clear when they start fighting among themselves. The traffic chaos eliminates most dangers except late-charging hold-up horses who find racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the 8 prominent runners create severe interference from 3f out
scenarios.body: The wall of prominent horses starts racing keenly and bunching badly as they fight for position behind Genesis, creating multiple incidents and blocked runs. This opens the door for any hold-up horse who can find a clean passage around the outside or gets a timely gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Genesis Cracks Under Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack puts early pressure on Genesis or he doesn't handle the long layoff
scenarios.body: Genesis shows rust from his 232-day break or gets hassled by the prominent runners tracking him, causing him to compound in the final furlong. The race becomes a cavalry charge between the prominent horses who avoided trouble and the best hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clean Hold-Up Victory
scenarios.trigger: If a hold-up horse gets perfect navigation through or around the prominent traffic
scenarios.body: One of the stronger hold-up horses benefits from the pace collapse and gets a dream run either inside or around the bunched prominent runners. They arrive with a devastating late surge as the pace-prominent horses tire from their positional battle.
